scope: Keyboard and CSS reduced-motion checks in isolated Chromium. Suggestion responses are controlled fixtures; topic lookup uses the local API. No report submitted; not a screen-reader audit.

results.check: Result count retains level-two heading semantics
Visible skip link transfers keyboard focus to main
Tab reaches labeled search after main focus
ArrowUp/ArrowDown wrap selection and Escape dismisses suggestions
Keyboard clear restores focus to the empty search
Explicit keyboard search works when suggestion lookup fails
Report disclosure, radio group and explanation work by keyboard
Reduced-motion preference disables CSS animation and transitions
